content.text: {"headline":"Approve P4: outage message, chat deflection, overtime for 15 payments agents, cancel coaching and delay breaks. It is the only plan that reaches the 80% target (80.5%) for 14:45-16:45, at ₹2,772.","why":"The spike is extra demand from the UPI outage (P1 incident INC-20261010-3825), not a staffing shortfall. Payments calls hit 123 per interval against a forecast of about 70-76, and upi_payment_failed calls ran at 2.66x normal. Staffing is close to plan (26 vs 27). P4 tackles both sides. The IVR outage message and 20% chat deflection cut demand, while overtime, the cancelled 15:30 coaching and delayed breaks add capacity. Predicted service level for the window is 80.5% (payments 78.8%, general 83.8%), with abandons at 5.1%. Rest of day is predicted at 84.7%. Doing nothing leaves the window at 64.1%, with payments at 57.4% and abandons at 10.4%.","trade_offs":["P2 (outage message, chat deflection and break delays) costs only ₹432 but reaches 74.5%, short of target, with payments at 71.2% and 6.6% abandons.","P3 (staffing only) costs more than P4 at ₹2,880 and reaches only 72.7%, because it does not reduce the outage calls.","P1 (no-cost break delays and callback) predicts 61.4%, slightly worse than doing nothing at 64.1%, so it is not worth using.","General queue is not put at risk by P4. It is predicted at 83.8%, above the 78.4% it would see with no action.","P4 clears the target by only 0.5 points and payments alone stays just under 80% (78.8%). There is little margin if the outage drags on or overtime uptake falls short of 15 agents."],"watch":"Check overtime uptake (15 agents needed) and payments service level each interval. Monitor the UPI incident: if it extends past 16:00 the measures will need extending. If upi_payment_failed volume stays high despite the IVR message, consider escalating. No duty manager escalation is flagged for now."}
